packName: ClearShift Canonical Dirty Data Pack V1

testScenariosProof.TS-01: A 1,000-row CSV runs through all 7 steps in one command line
testScenariosProof.TS-02: The profile finds exactly 80 duplicates, 60 bad formats, 50 empty required fields
testScenariosProof.TS-03: Exact duplicates inside the file are merged; the merge count equals 80
testScenariosProof.TS-04: Dry run changes nothing in target tables
testScenariosProof.TS-05: A row with an invalid email is rejected with "Email is not valid: value has no @ sign"
testScenariosProof.TS-06: Reconciliation is exact: 1000 = 810 (loaded) + 110 (rejected) + 80 (merged) + 0 (skipped); unaccounted = 0; status OK
testScenariosProof.TS-07: Raw tables and source file remain unchanged (SHA-256 verified)
testScenariosProof.TS-08: A file with 40% broken rows stops load at 10% failures with STP-01 circuit breaker

forty_percent_invalid.description: Preflight predicts 40% invalid rows without mutating target DB; real load trips 10% circuit breaker (STP-01)
forty_percent_invalid.expectedBehavior: Preflight 40% rejects in dry-run; Load halts at failure threshold > 10% with STOP_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED and 0 unaccounted rows

unresolved_transient_failure.description: Simulates network partition / database lock timeout exhausting bounded retries
unresolved_transient_failure.expectedBehavior: Batch halts safely; preserves durable receipt state; no partial corrupt mutations or dropped rows

duplicate_delivery.description: At-least-once message delivery with repeated identical rows and payload drift check
duplicate_delivery.expectedBehavior: Subsequent deliveries return prior target IDs (isExisting: true); drifted payloads return 409 Conflict

missing_parent.fixtureName: Missing Parent Entity Referential Integrity Rejection
missing_parent.description: Child records referencing non-existent parent company UUIDs

invalid_enum.description: Records with unknown enum status values

protected_opt_out.description: Contacts with explicit GDPR/privacy opt-out flags
protected_opt_out.expectedBehavior: Safely protected/skipped with PROTECTED_OPT_OUT reason; zero outbound marketing delivery
